_comment: Two process passes 10 s apart, as SnapshotSampler sees them while idle. PIDs, names and uids are from a Mac17,9 (M5 Pro) on macOS 27.0; the byte counts are shaped from a real NetworkStatistics query. The app runs as uid 501, so only uid 501 processes get a rate. claude: steady traffic. Claude Helper: a connection closed between the passes; the monitor's ledger keeps its bytes, so the cumulative figure still only grows. identityservicesd: no sockets at all now (absent from current), so 0. rapportd: rx went backwards (a restarted count), so rx is 0 for this pass while tx still has a rate. ControlCenter: PID 659 now belongs to a different process (new start time), so 0. swift-frontend: first sight, so 0. mDNSResponder runs as _mdnsresponder (uid 65): its sockets aren't visible, so no rate at all.
